The Catalyst Strategic NZ-US Joint Antarctic Research Programme pilot project on rapid sea
ice decline in the Ross Sea began on 1 October 2025, with Rodrigo Gomez-Fell as a
postdoctoral researcher. See the [project description](../projects.qmd#ross-sea-ice).
